news.headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh says X-rays on QB Justin Herbert's finger negative
news.description: X-rays on the injured middle finger of Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert's left hand came back negative for a fracture, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday.

news.headline: Sources: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew has UCL injury; Michael Wilson out for year
news.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew will likely need season-ending surgery on his right UCL, sources told ESPN. Michael Wilson, Arizona's top wide receiver, is also out for the season with a neck injury.

news.headline: Brandon Aiyuk reinstated by NFL; 49ers have 2-game roster exemption for receiver
